edits.text: Early accounts interpret 早 as 日 above 甲: 日 depicts the sun, while 甲 contributes “first,” suggesting the sun’s initial appearance. A separate analysis of later-bronze forms treats 日 as meaningful and 棗, sometimes reduced to 朿, as the sound element. The forms cannot be visually compared here, and the evidence does not establish a sequence linking these analyses. [E3] [X-fe32703e608baebfe293] [X-38ce8bf92100d2590889] [X-9d85d94b6e414dfb0375]
